faq: When is the tiramisu available?
Thursday to Sunday, and it sells out quickly. Pre-order a tub (RM21 at our other outlets) or a tray to be sure.

faq: How do I order?
Add the kuih to your cart and choose a pick-up or delivery date at checkout. You can also order on WhatsApp (011-1165 5688) or on Instagram (@secawantepung).
Where is pick-up?
South Bangsar, Kuala Lumpur. We'll WhatsApp you the exact pick-up point and time after you order.
Do you deliver?
Yes, by Grab or Lalamove. The fee depends on the distance and is confirmed with you before delivery.
How is the kuih sold?
Per 100 pieces. Choose from 22 types of kuih talam, kuih lapis, angku, bingka ubi and more, sweet and savoury. WhatsApp us for the full list.
Can you cater for a party or open house?
Yes. Send us the date and the number of guests on WhatsApp and we'll send you a quote.
Do you have Raya cookies?
Yes, for the Raya season. Ask us what's available this year.
